title: trailboss --json thread

cost_usd.description: The turn's API-equivalent cost in dollars, rounded to cents; null when no response has a price.

ended.description: The last reply, tool result or response in the turn (ISO 8601); null when there's none yet.

from.description: "you" for a prompt you sent; "agent" for a message the agent sent into the session itself, such as a background task's report.

model.description: The model of the turn's last response; null without usage.

n.description: The turn's number in the session, from 1. Stable while the session grows.

reply.description: The agent's replies in the turn, joined by a blank line; Markdown as the agent wrote it. Empty while it hasn't replied.

responses.description: How many API responses the turn took.

tokens.description: Tokens the turn's responses used, cache reads and writes included.

tools.description: How many tool results the turn has (those with output).

description: One session as a conversation, oldest turn first. A turn starts at each prompt; it holds the replies and usage up to the next prompt. Slash commands and their output are left out. Built from the index, so it shows what was indexed: prompts and replies in full, thinking and tool output not at all.
